auth.detail:
Set VERCEL_TOKEN or run vercel login. CLI detail: Error: No existing credentials found. Please run `vercel login` or pass "--token"
Learn More: https://err.sh/vercel/no-credentials-found

project.detail: Run `vercel link --yes --team <team-id> --project <project-name-or-id>` or configure VERCEL_ORG_ID and VERCEL_PROJECT_ID for non-interactive deploys.
